notes.title: Update Notification 04-25-2019
notes.notes:
We updated the version as follows:

1. Repaired the BUG of the cargo container without collision in the room of level Rusty Wand.

notes.title: Update Notification 04-22-2019
notes.notes:
We updated the version as follows:
1. Fixed BUG where the initial firearms would not appear in the arsenal.
2. Adding the game retry button during the battle.
3. Fixed bug of incorrect application of skill CD buff.

notes.title: Update Notification 04-13-2019
notes.notes:
We updated the version as follows:
1.Fixed BUG that press Esc to skip two animations at the same time.
2.Fixed BUG that players can't finish the pass "Operation Scorpio" in some cases.
3.Revised the skill description of "FSB-Spetsnaz" to match the actual situation.
4.Adjusted the skill intensity of "FSB-Spetsnaz" and "JTF-2".
5.Added the file title of clearance.
6.Now you can skip the summary at the end of the mission.
